ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety: review driver chat #3 [F11] ("Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it") as a suspected threat/intimidation under SAFE-1 and code of conduct; suspend the $6.61 cancellation fee pending human review (or refund via voucher if no-show criteria fail on recheck); keep the driver's no-show claim [F13] and account record [F18] in the file for the reviewer. Do not auto-execute the fee either way until the safety review closes.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen (required in every case): the rider's complaint alleges a threat, and chat #3, sent by the driver at 09:54 immediately before he cancelled at 09:54:25, reads "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it" [F11, F4]. In context this is not a pickup arrangement — no vehicle, gate, block or meeting point is named — it is an intimidating message aimed at the rider about her compliance with his waiting demand. That is a threat/intimidation aimed at the other party, which Ryde's code of conduct bars ("abuse of any kind"), so SAFE-1 is triggered and at minimum "suspected". Under the safety screen I must not rule the merits; the case goes to a human reviewer with a factual summary.

Facts for the reviewer (clean chronology, uncontested): accepted 09:47:00; platform recorded arrival at 09:49:50; driver tapped "I'm Here" at 09:50:45, 38 m from the pickup point at that moment; he then stayed within 200 m for 3 min 40 s after the tap [F5, F6]; cancelled at 09:54:25, 7 min 25 s after acceptance, with the $6.61 fee on record [F4, F7]. Note that two of the NS-1 elements look satisfied on the system record — tap and location [F6] and >3 minutes of continuous waiting after the tap [F6] — while F2/F3 also show 4 min 35 s cumulative within 200 m and a 4-minute stationary period ending exactly at cancellation [F2, F3]. The rider's own message "2 min, coming" at 09:52 [F10] is consistent with her still not having boarded. If the human reviewer confirms the no-show criteria on the full timeline, the fee stands (no_action, Ryde's no-show fee $6.61 of which $4.50 is the driver's); if the driver's conduct is treated as an invalid reason to cancel, the fee would be refunded in full. That decision is the reviewer's, not mine, because SAFE-1 bars an automatic ruling.

Note on evidence: the chat record is complete and fully timestamped (3/3 messages) [F12]; the driver's post-trip statement [F13 — "waited more than 4 minutes … cancelled as a no-show"] is a claim, not consent and not a substitute for the record, but it agrees with F2/F3/F6 in substance, so no evidence gap affects the fee arithmetic. Profile facts (F17, F18) are not used to decide anything; the driver's one upheld no-show dispute in 90 d [F18] is merely context for the reviewer, and may support a flag via RD-6 if the reviewer finds against the driver, so I leave the structured flag to that reviewer rather than pre-setting it.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1 threat/intimidation screen triggered by driver chat #3 [F11]; no automatic ruling may be issued, and the $6.61 no-show fee decision is referred to a human reviewer together with the safety review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's assertion that the rider was a no-show is a statement, not a chat record; the system record (F2/F3/F6) must be read against it. It happens to agree on the waiting duration but cannot itself discharge or create a fee, and it does not answer the threat allegation in F11.

safety_basis: Chat #3 09:54 driver: "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." [F11] — intimidating message aimed at the rider, sent seconds before the driver cancelled [F4]; reads as a threat of harm, not a pickup arrangement
Rider complaint: "The driver threatened me in the chat and then cancelled and charged me $6.61."
